The universe is linear (as in time as we currently understand it) but trends are cyclical ( again as we understand it).

The point of our understanding is rarely mentioned or emphasized in education, but it the crucial point of reference for the basis of all understanding.

Everything is defined based on what we can understand a comprehend.

A day, one of the earliest units for measuring time, is simply how often a flaming gas ball first comes into view to when it first comes into view again.

That is it.

24 hours make up a day not a day is composed of 24 hours. Hours was a way of sub-dividing what we defined as a day. WE took this span and divided it by 24 to help US subdivide the time within a day to better allocate the time spent for an activity or activities in a day.

Yet, a light year is a measurement of distance as time. E.g. the distance light travels in one year. (365 days).

But for all we think we know we could be just a goddamn particle spinning around an ember flying off of someone's campfire.

The fact we are limited by our own understanding is not talked about much because we as a species like top think that we have good and solid grasp of the world around us. Hell just a few hundred years ago we thought that the world was flat.

Yet, to the point, the universe is linear for a few reasons:

  1. We do not know the origins of the universe (i.e. what cause the universe to be),

  2. To the best of our, very limited, knowledge the universe has yet to repeat itself, and

3, The universe has not ended, again, to our knowledge.

These three facts illustrate, yet again to our knowledge, that the universe is linear not cyclical. Nothing has begun, ended, or been repeated on the scale of the universe. Sure the universe started some how (possible the Big Bang) but it obviously has not ended as we are still here discussing it. To the best of our knowledge the universe has not repeated itself. However, this is a biased Human view point. The universe may have caused the rise of a higher intelligence somewhere else in the universe while Earth was the domain of the dinosaurs, and we would have no knowledge of this fact. Because humans did not exist at that time.

In conclusion: the universe is linear based on the limited information available at this time.
